lactate.rationale: Highest documented survivable lactate ~25 mmol/L. Cap 30 with buffer.

ph.rationale: pH outside 6.5-7.9 incompatible with life. Values in billions are data errors.

pco2.rationale: Extreme hypercapnia documented up to ~150-180 mmHg in severe COPD/asthma.

pao2.rationale: Maximum on 100% FiO2 ~500-600 mmHg. Higher values are calibration errors.

bicarbonate.rationale: Extreme metabolic alkalosis documented up to ~50 mmol/L.

base_excess.rationale: Extreme BE values documented at ±40. Cap ±50 with buffer.

anion_gap.rationale: Extreme AG in severe metabolic acidosis up to ~50.

spo2_lab.rationale: SpO2 is a percentage. Cannot exceed 100. Below 50 patient would be dead.

platelets.rationale: Extreme thrombocytosis documented up to ~1500. Cap 2000 with buffer.

inr.rationale: INR >20 essentially unmeasurable — extreme coagulopathy. Real values rarely exceed 15.

ddimer.rationale: Extreme D-dimer in severe DIC documented up to ~150. Cap 200 with buffer.

fibrinogen.rationale: Maximum fibrinogen in acute phase response ~10-12 g/L.

pt.rationale: Extreme PT in severe coagulopathy documented up to ~150s.

ptt.rationale: Extreme PTT in severe coagulopathy documented up to ~250s.

creatinine_umol.rationale: 2000 umol/L = ~22.6 mg/dL. Extreme renal failure with dialysis. Higher values are errors.

bilirubin_umol.rationale: 1800 umol/L = ~105 mg/dL. Extreme in biliary atresia neonates. Negative values are errors.

alt.rationale: Extreme ALT in acute liver failure documented >30,000. Cap 50,000 with buffer.

glucose_mmol.rationale: 80 mmol/L = ~1440 mg/dL. Extreme hyperglycaemic crisis. Higher values are errors.

anc.rationale: Extreme neutrophilia in leukaemoid reaction documented up to ~80.

alc.rationale: Extreme lymphocytosis in CLL-like picture documented up to ~80.

wbc.rationale: Extreme leukocytosis in leukaemia documented up to ~200-250.

hemoglobin.rationale: Highest documented haemoglobin ~23-24 g/dL in extreme polycythaemia.

hematocrit.rationale: Cannot exceed 100%. Extreme polycythaemia documented up to ~70%.

calcium.rationale: Extreme hypercalcaemia documented up to ~4.5 mmol/L.

albumin.rationale: Normal range 35-50 g/L. Values above 70 are errors.

crp.rationale: Extreme CRP in severe sepsis/inflammation documented up to ~400 mg/L.

ldh.rationale: Extreme LDH in haemolysis/malignancy documented up to ~50,000.

urea.rationale: Extreme uraemia documented up to ~80 mmol/L.

uric_acid.rationale: Extreme in tumour lysis syndrome documented up to ~1500 umol/L.

ck.rationale: Extreme CK in rhabdomyolysis documented up to ~500,000 IU/L.

heart_rate.rationale: Absolute maximum in documented SVT/VT ~320 bpm. Cap 350 with buffer. Value 9718 is a data error.

resp_rate.rationale: Maximum documented RR in severe distress ~80-90/min. Value 2694 is a data error.

temperature.rationale: Lowest documented survival hypothermia ~27C. Cap floor 30 with buffer. Maximum hyperthermia ~43C. Value 337 is a data error.

systolic_bp.rationale: Extreme hypertensive crisis documented up to ~300 mmHg. Value 1108 is a data error.

diastolic_bp.rationale: Extreme diastolic hypertension documented up to ~180 mmHg.

spo2_chart.rationale: SpO2 is a percentage. Cannot exceed 100. Below 50 patient would be dead.
